pages.text: There's a pyramid in the desert that isn't like the others. The locals won't go near it.$(br2)Whatever is inside won't wake on its own. It wakes for one thing: the Necklace of the Desert. I'd rather it stayed asleep, but you need what it's holding.
$(o)The Ancient Remnant sleeps on the Old Eye, inside the Cursed Pyramid out in the desert.$()
